description: Create or replace ONE finished good's bill of materials (finished good by item id or SKU) with the complete component list given: lines not in the list are removed. Components resolve by SKU in the finished good's client namespace and must already exist (labor/overhead lines are noninventory items); nothing is auto-created. The preview shows the BOM before and after with added, removed and changed lines. Preview first, then repeat identical arguments with previewReceipt and a fresh idempotencyKey. Requires Write + manufacturing.execute and the Manufacturing plan. To seed many BOMs at once use upsert_bills_of_materials. In-app assistants get a confirm card the user applies.

components.description: The complete component list (1–500 lines): component SKU and quantity per unit, optional uom, scrapPercentage, isOptional, note, isPhantom, subAssemblyBomId.

scrapPercentage.description: Optional expected scrap/waste as a PERCENTAGE from 0 to 100: 5 means 5% extra material (send 5, not 0.05). Planning and production consumption use quantity × (1 + scrapPercentage / 100). Default 0.

finishedGood.description: The finished good's item id (GUID) or SKU.

idempotencyKey.description: Caller-generated idempotency key; required with previewReceipt to commit.

note.description: Optional BOM note. Omit to keep the current note; an empty string clears it.

preview.description: Step 1 of the required two-step write: set true to validate and receive a structured preview plus a single-use previewReceipt. Nothing changes until the commit call.

previewReceipt.description: Step 2 of the required two-step write: the receipt returned by the preview call. Supply together with a fresh idempotencyKey to commit; calls without it are refused.
